changeSet.author: yambo
changeSet.comment: Simplify issue workflow to OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, CLOSED. Migrate legacy values: RESOLVED(2) -> CLOSED(2), CLOSED(3) -> CLOSED(2), REOPENED(4) -> OPEN(0).
changeSet.sql: UPDATE issue SET status = CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 0 WHEN status = 3 THEN 2 ELSE status END WHERE status IN (3, 4);
UPDATE issue_comment SET status = CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 0 WHEN status = 3 THEN 2 ELSE status END WHERE status IN (3, 4);
